answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the echo of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the kernel re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the island of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
